source: A common incorrect summary is “ZXNAME0000XZ reduces attention IO fromZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ toZXMATH0002XZ The linear quantity is the large auxiliary memory footprint with respect to sequence length, not the general ZXNAME0001XZ-access expression above. Intuitively, more usable on-chip memory lets larger working tiles stay resident and be reused for more attention work before data must be reloaded from ZXNAME0002XZ. In the theorem's regime, that increased reuse is why the ZXNAME0003XZ-access bound decreases as M grows.
zh: 一个常见的错误总结是“ZXNAME0000XZ 减少了从 ZXMATH0000XZ ZXMATH0001XZ 到 ZXMATH0002XZ 的注意力 IO。线性量是相对于序列长度的大辅助内存占用，而不是上面一般的 ZXNAME0001XZ 访问表达式。直观地说，更可用的片上内存可以让更大的工作块驻留并在必须重新加载数据之前重用以进行更多注意力工作来自 ZXNAME0002XZ 在定理的体系中，增加的重用是 ZXNAME0003XZ 访问界限随着 M 的增长而减少的原因。
